name: Kakouton
source:
A loyalist from Sou Sou's inner circle who serves him at the risk of his own life.

A hard-headed elite general. He is bound by social norms and stereotypes, and hates Maozoku and women. He is absolutely loyal to Sou Sou and only thinks about what is in his best interest. He is always with his cousin Kakou En. Through their battles to date, he has come to recognize Kan'U a little as a warrior, but he is by no means open-minded. He is still prejudiced against the thirteen tribes, and he is not amused that Sou Sou still desires the power of the Juuza.

"I wonder why. Your crying face tightens up my chest."

[translated from [url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/fammysgogo/archives/1798174.html]fammysgogo[/url]]
